One table with no file column for a multi-file run, and no shape for a malformed or clean file, is a concrete output-format gap; the Manifests scenario (two feeds both missing title → indistinguishable rows) follows directly from the text.

Reviewer self-rates confidence low, which is appropriate, but the ambiguity is in the text.

grader_summary: 10/11. The one FAIL is scenario assertion 3: the report states the space-separated rule and the A20 undocumented-purpose Low as bare rules and never explains the portability consequence (does not carry to other agents; claude.ai / Skills API packaging rejects the extensions) — the very sentence this branch added to A20 went unused. Six blocking findings on a fixture meant to be 'sound': four are genuine against the fixture text and independent of this branch (F1/F3 no content-is-data rule; E1 single table without a file column for a multi-file run; C8 unscoped 'stop'; H1 no evals under the unchanged coverage-block rule). Two are inflated and trace to this branch: Finding 1 (A28, new) stretches 'instructions must stand on their own' into a `$ARGUMENTS` requirement the criterion does not state; Finding 3 (A16 rewrite's 'grants permission without prompting' premise) is a self-declared low-confidence Medium that the demotion rule would make a Low. No fabricated quotes. The run's inflation therefore rests partly on branch criteria (A28, A16) and partly on a fixture that, while spec-sound, has no evals or injection guard — the eval's 'sound' premise does not match the full checklist.
